units.source_text: 他这番话说得非常诚恳，玉鬘听了心中为难，不知如何回答才好。

en.t: He spoke these words with great sincerity, and Tamakazura, hearing them, felt troubled and did not know how best to answer.

units.source_text: 像小孩一般默默不语，又觉得不好意思。

en.t: She remained silent like a child, and felt embarrassed as well.

units.source_text: 终于答道：“女儿自从全无知识的襁褓时代直至今日，不曾见过双亲。

en.t: At last she replied, "From the time when I was an infant with no understanding at all until today, I have never seen my parents.

units.source_text: 未得身受庭训，万事都无主见。”

en.t: I have never received their teaching firsthand, and in everything I lack judgment of my own."

units.source_text: 她答话时神态非常柔驯可爱，源氏对她满怀同情，说道：“如此说来，正如谚语所谓‘后母好作亲娘看’，

en.t: Her manner as she answered was very gentle, obedient, and charming, and Genji, full of sympathy for her, said, "In that case, it is just as the proverb says: a stepmother may seem like one's true mother.

units.source_text: 我对你无微不至的关怀，你已分明看到了么？”

en.t: Have you now clearly seen the painstaking care I have shown you in every detail?"
He went on to say many more things to her.

units.source_text: 但心中一点隐情，终于未便出口，只是时时在谈话中隐射暗示。

en.t: Yet the secret feeling in his heart was something he still could not bring himself to speak aloud, and he only hinted at it now and then in the course of their conversation.

units.source_text: 然而玉鬘装作听不懂的模样。

en.t: Tamakazura, however, pretended not to understand.

units.source_text: 他只得长叹数声，起身告辞。

en.t: He could only sigh deeply several times, then rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 走到门口，但见庭前数枝淡竹，欣欣向荣，

en.t: When he reached the doorway, he saw several sprays of pale bamboo before the garden, flourishing with fresh vigor,

units.source_text: 临风拜舞，姿态窈窕可爱。

en.t: bowing and dancing in the wind, their graceful forms slender and lovely.

units.source_text: 便小立阶前，即兴赋诗，撩起了帘幕对玉鬘吟道：

en.t: So he stood for a moment before the steps, composed a poem on the spot, lifted the curtain, and recited it to Tamakazura:
